newsitem.title: USA: Storage USA to tap corp debt primary mart.
newsitem.headline: Storage USA to tap corp debt primary mart.

text.p: Storage USA Inc is slated to tap the corporate bond primary market with $100 million in debt on Wednesday, syndicate sources said on Tuesday.
The Baa3/BBB-minus rated deal is expected to include a 10-year or 20-year maturity, sources said.
Goldman Sachs & Co is expected to lead underwrite the offering.
Storage USA, based in Columbia, Maryland, is a self-managed, self-advised real estate investment trust, owning, managing, acquiring, developing and franchising self-storage facilities.
Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, which may include repayment of debt, making improvements to properties, and the acquisition and development of additional properties.
